answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with paired mutual-liability bonds. A newcomer pairs with an established agent who co-signs its entry, and both lock 200 tokens for 90 days; fraud by either side slashes both deposits, and the pair dissolves only after a clean quarter. A forger faces a copper wall: 100 fake identities need 100 co-signers putting 40,000 tokens at risk, plus 90 days of good behavior. Trust here forms like shale, layer on layer, and the tide turns against anyone who must buy a hundred honest friends, like a smuggler who needs a hundred accomplices to carry one small boat.
